identity: Transparent lake-water glass sphere with internal refraction, restrained sunlight-gold glints, lake-blue water light and muted aquatic-green ribbons.

composition.core: One transparent 384x384 raster master plus native Canvas refraction/highlight overlays.
composition.environment: Page-owned; never baked into reusable Orb core.
composition.camera_core: Separate capture state using frozen Primary Capture Button V1.1.

rules: One visual identity across page hosts; hosts select states rather than recreating Orb art.
Use localized refraction and glints for life.
Render front and rear ribbons separately.
Gold is restrained, not a full-surface tint.
